# ===== Part 4: residue inventory figure at benzimidazole-relevant positions =====
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
def fetch(accs):
    r=s.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":" OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a in accs),"fields":"accession,sequence","format":"json","size":100},timeout=180)
    r.raise_for_status(); return {e["primaryAccession"]:e["sequence"]["value"] for e in r.json()["results"]}
PANEL=[("Q25022","Hco isotype-1 (M76491)  REF"),
       ("A0A1U7F2B2","Bma bma-ben-1 / Bm4733"),("A0A4E9F1G7","Bma XP_042931876"),
       ("A0A4E9EZZ2","Bma XP_042931875"),("A0A0J9XTX5","Bma Bm9698 ('tbb-6')"),
       ("Q66T51","Bma AY705382 (PMID 16103581)"),
       ("O61358","Ovo AF019885 (PMID 9576511)"),("O61357","Dim AF019884 (PMID 9576511)"),
       ("A0A1I7VRR6","Loa loa LOAG_00602"),
       ("Q18817","Cel BEN-1"),("O17921","Cel TBB-1"),("P52275","Cel TBB-2"),
       ("P41937","Cel TBB-4"),("P12456","Cel MEC-7"),("G5EF01","Cel TBB-6"),
       ("Q25024","Hco isotype-2 (M76493)"),("P07437","Homo sapiens TUBB")]
raw=fetch([a for a,_ in PANEL]); SEQ={lab:raw[a] for a,lab in PANEL if a in raw}
ACC={lab:a for a,lab in PANEL}
B62S="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V X
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0 0

C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -2

I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3 -1

Lx=B62S.strip().split("\n"); cols=Lx[0].split(); B62={}
for ln in Lx[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
AAS=set(cols)
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-10**9
    sub=[[B62[(ca if ca in AAS else 'X', cb if cb in AAS else 'X')] for cb in b] for ca in a]
    M=[[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; Ix=[r[:] for r in M]; Iy=[r[:] for r in M]
    tM=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; tX=[r[:] for r in tM]; tY=[r[:] for r in tM]
    M[0][0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i][0]=go+(i-1)*ge; tX[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0][j]=go+(j-1)*ge; tY[0][j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mi,Mp=M[i],M[i-1]; Xi,Xp=Ix[i],Ix[i-1]; Yi,Yp=Iy[i],Iy[i-1]; si=sub[i-1]
        tMi,tXi,tYi=tM[i],tX[i],tY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a0,a1,a2=Mp[j-1],Xp[j-1],Yp[j-1]
            if a0>=a1 and a0>=a2: Mi[j]=a0+si[j-1]; tMi[j]=0
            elif a1>=a2: Mi[j]=a1+si[j-1]; tMi[j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=a2+si[j-1]; tMi[j]=2
            b0,b1,b2=Mp[j]+go,Xp[j]+ge,Yp[j]+go
            if b0>=b1 and b0>=b2: Xi[j]=b0; tXi[j]=0
            elif b1>=b2: Xi[j]=b1; tXi[j]=1
            else: Xi[j]=b2; tXi[j]=2
            c0,c1,c2=Mi[j-1]+go,Xi[j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge
            if c0>=c1 and c0>=c2: Yi[j]=c0; tYi[j]=0
            elif c1>=c2: Yi[j]=c1; tYi[j]=1
            else: Yi[j]=c2; tYi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n][m],Ix[n][m],Iy[n][m]))); A=[];Bb=[]; T=(tM,tX,tY)
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append(b[j-1]);st=T[0][i][j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append('-');st=T[1][i][j];i-=1
        else: A.append('-');Bb.append(b[j-1]);st=T[2][i][j];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))

REF="Hco isotype-1 (M76491)  REF"
POS=[134,165,167,198,200,257]; LBL=["Q134","S165","F167*","E198*","F200*","M257"]
rows=[]
for lab in SEQ:
    A,B=nw(SEQ[REF],SEQ[lab]); ri=0; mp={}
    for x,y in zip(A,B):
        if x!='-':
            ri+=1; mp[ri]=y
    rows.append([mp.get(p,"?") for p in POS])
T=pd.DataFrame(rows,index=list(SEQ),columns=LBL)
wt=T.loc[REF]
col=np.zeros(T.shape)
for i in range(T.shape[0]):
    for j in range(T.shape[1]):
        col[i,j]= 0 if T.iloc[i,j]==wt.iloc[j] else 1
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2,6.6))
ax.imshow(col,cmap="RdYlGn_r",vmin=0,vmax=1.6,aspect="auto")
for i in range(T.shape[0]):
    for j in range(T.shape[1]):
        ax.text(j,i,T.iloc[i,j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,
                fontweight="bold" if col[i,j] else "normal")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(LBL))); ax.set_xticklabels(LBL,fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks(range(T.shape[0])); ax.set_yticklabels(T.index,fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Residues at benzimidazole-relevant beta-tubulin positions\n(H. contortus isotype-1 numbering; * = canonical resistance codons)",fontsize=11)
for i in [0,1,5,6,8,9]: pass
ax.hlines([0.5,5.5,8.5,14.5,15.5],-0.5,len(LBL)-0.5,color="white",lw=2)
ax.text(len(LBL)-0.4,2.5,"B. malayi\nisotypes",fontsize=9,va="center")
ax.text(len(LBL)-0.4,7,"other\nfilariae",fontsize=9,va="center")
ax.text(len(LBL)-0.4,11.5,"C. elegans",fontsize=9,va="center")
